attributes.name: Druva - Recovery Outside Business Hours
attributes.description: Detects recovery or restore activity occurring outside the configured 07:00–19:00 UTC review window.
author: Druva
tags: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations

meta.pack: Druva Detection Pack 3 – Cyber Recovery & Recovery Operations
meta.customer_usecase: Detects recovery or restore activity occurring outside the configured 07:00–19:00 UTC review window.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| EVAL event_text = TO_LOWER(COALESCE(TO_STRING(message), TO_STRING(druva.event_type), ""))
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| EVAL event_hour = DATE_EXTRACT("hour_of_day", event_time)
| WHERE event_text LIKE "*recover*" OR event_text LIKE "*restore*"
| WHERE event_hour < 7 OR event_hour >= 19
